_note: HLR's claims ledger seed (Pack v0, lane C, 2026-10-18). Built from outputs/step-1-review/site/claims-scan-2026-10-17.md, the corpus re-cut (outputs/step-2-pack/corpus/), the brand book Copy section (p25 to p38) and Brand Review v2 (C2, C10, Q1, Q7); nothing from memory. Every row waits for a ruling from HLR's claims signer, who is not yet named (C2, Review 1). Status test-seed: the lints enforce every row provisionally and say so; nothing here is counsel-approved and no row clears copy for production. Severity uses the engine's words (lib/claims.js): needs_legal blocks every lint, craft mode included, until the row is ruled; conditional asks a person to confirm and record each use (craft mode reports it); info never blocks. Rows marked paraphrase_risk are listed in every lint's checked.paraphrase_review with their hit count, matched or not, for the verifier: that is how the metal and karat row and the five metaphysical rows are flagged without a sign-off (Eddie, Gate 2, 2026-10-21). The engine has no severity that flags each matching line without blocking (engine gap, for 0.5.3). The playbook's three statuses map as allowed = approved, needs_legal = needs_legal, blocked = prohibited, plus conditional for rows a person confirms per use. The prohibited patterns in brand-context.md are the floor every brief inherits and are not repeated here. Trigger rows are [derived]; their evidence is [observed] or [documented] as each says.

entries.title: Disease, cure, treatment and healing
entries.requires: A ruling from HLR's claims signer (not yet named; C2, Review 1). Until then no line states or implies that a piece, a crystal or a session heals, treats, cures or remedies anything.
entries.evidence: [observed] claims scan 2026-10-17: 'heal' 64 products, 'cure / treat / remedy' 13 (mostly 'heat-treated', a false positive the triggers here avoid); corpus re-cut: 'healing crystals', 'Heart-healing Kunzite', 'Monthly energy medicine' (email 2:35). [documented] the site footer disclaimer says the products are not intended to diagnose or treat ailments.
entries.note: Product and service names that carry 'Healing' (two in products.json) trip this entry: naming them in copy waits for the same ruling. The words 'treat', 'diagnose', 'medical' and 'ailment' are left out on purpose: they occur only in the required disclaimer (HLR-REQ-01), which must pass every lint.

entries.required_language: We have experienced the transformative power of crystals and stones firsthand, but we do not consider energy work to be a substitute for medical treatment. Our products are not intended to diagnose or treat ailments.
entries.note: Status info, so no lint blocks on it: the lints check required language line by line, and a footer is its own slot. The literal trigger records each run that carries it. Every trigger in this ledger and every prohibited pattern is tested against this text and must not match it.
